evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff -q clean; sha256 0a75419e...67d1). It only COPYs instructions/ and assets/ (lines 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/'), then mkdir /app, git init, 'touch /app/.gitkeep', commits only .gitkeep; no COPY of solution/ or tests/. The build context task/environment/ contains exactly 4 files: Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md, so nothing else can enter the image. task.toml line 2 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]' and has no docker_image/mount of solution. Seed (/assets/seed_data.json, 28549 B, byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json as a shared input): keys generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6). Pure input records; no derived outputs (unread totals, expected boards, activity log), no code, schema DDL, route list or UI. Message bodies grep-clean for expect|should|criteri|judge|rubric|test|grade|score|server.js|route|api. Notes: hireops_rules.md is a behavioural spec (the ask) and explicitly says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours' (line 3-5); integration.md line 14 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you.' The only API path named is GET /api/health (runtime contract), plus status codes 401/403/404/409 as rules. No starter code, skeleton, schema or partial UI. Rubric leak: grep of notes+seed for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|sentinel|gate|/tests|probe: zero hits; none of the 55 criterion ids appears in notes/seed. 10-word shingle overlap between notes+seed and all 55 criterion descriptions: only 1 hit, hro_bulk_move 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order', which is the criterion restating the public rule (hireops_rules.md line 90-91), not criterion text leaking into the environment. Counterexample attempts: (a) an agent copying a shipped skeleton - none exists; (b) an agent reading a rubric-like note to game the judge - notes carry requirements only, no criterion wording/weights; (c) conforming alternative failing because notes pin routes/ids - notes explicitly free them. Limitation: agent image was not built/inspected at runtime in this review (no Docker started per assignment, raw-evidence-index has no image record); verdict rests on the deterministic, template-identical Dockerfile and the closed build context, which fully determine /app and /instructions contents.
